depiction.composition: single object, side profile, outline style

readings.meaning: desk spotlight, smart lamp, or floodlight on a stand
webcam or home security camera on a base

ambiguity: Strongly resembles a geometric lowercase letter 'g' or an abstract logo rather than a physical object; even when read as hardware, it is hard to tell whether it is a lamp, a webcam, or a speaker.

reasoning: The glyph consists of two simple loops joined by a short diagonal stroke and cannot be reliably identified at a glance: viewers are as likely to read it as a lowercase letter 'g' or an abstract logo as a desk spotlight or webcam. Because a clear bulb, lamp shade, or camera lens icon communicates lighting or video tasks far better, this icon is too ambiguous to serve as a glanceable reminder.
